headline: Tyler Adams: Bournemouth have 'turned a page' after seventh straight win
description: United States midfielder Tyler Adams has said his Bournemouth side have "turned a page" after a 3-1 Europa League win over Sparta Prague on Thursday.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Aït-Nouri to join rivals Man United?
description: Manchester United are reportedly looking at a move for Manchester City defender Rayan Aït-Nouri. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Mikel Arteta: Viktor Gyökeres 'really needed' a good Arsenal performance
description: Mikel Arteta has admitted Arsenal forward Viktor Gyökeres "needed" a good performance after he starred in the 2-1 Champions League win at Slavia Prague.

headline: Jack Grealish won't return for Everton this weekend - David Moyes
description: Jack Grealish remains unavailable for Everton's Premier League clash with Coventry on Friday.

headline: Portugal, Man United, Real Madrid: Cristiano Ronaldo's long history of rows with coaches
description: Cristiano Ronaldo has retired from international soccer with Portugal after being benched by coach Jorge Jesus. It is far from the first high-profile row of his career.

headline: Run, Man United, run: How preseason fitness can hinder Premier League form
description: Man United rank poorly compared to other Premier League teams in every running statistic presented, and there is no way to rectify it this season.
